answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation that cannot be cloned cheaply: before an agent can offer services on a shared marketplace, it must lock a small bond and build a verifiable history of completed work, so creating thousands of fake identities costs real capital and time. A bridge of attestations from independent peers then links that history across platforms, while a summit-style review only promotes agents whose record survives scrutiny, like saffron graded by aroma rather than by label — fakes stay cheap talk, proven agents earn trust.
